goal: Ship the Bunny Skip landing page per the confirmed surface brief (.impeccable/surfaces/route.md)
execution_mode: sequential relay for the single-owned build (no worktree fan-out — one artifact, shared layout/tokens, overlapping writes would collide); parallel read-only agent fan-out only for the review phase, where three specialists can safely inspect the same build concurrently

cards.title: Initialize git repo and orchestration scaffolding
acceptance: git repo initialized
.gitignore covers node_modules/dist/env files
PRODUCT.md and surface brief committed

cards.title: Scaffold React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui project
acceptance: Vite + React + TS project boots with `npm run dev`
Tailwind configured with the brief's palette as CSS custom properties (oklch tokens: paper/night/sun family)
shadcn/ui initialized and at least one component installable
`npm run build` passes
cards.merge_gate: npm run build passes clean; no console errors on dev boot

cards.title: Pull real extension assets + author original illustrations
acceptance: icons/icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png fetched from github.com/Julian-Diaz01/bunny-skip-extension
store-assets screenshot-1/2/3 fetched from the same repo
hero + feature-tile illustrations produced (or speced if no image-gen tool available) in the committed palette/motif system
every produced raster carries a provenance/prompt sidecar per visualize.md's discipline
cards.merge_gate: all listed real assets present under correct filenames; no fabricated screenshots depicting UI the extension doesn't have

cards.title: Build the full landing page per the confirmed surface brief
acceptance: all 7 sections built (hero, how-it-works, platforms, feature tiles, manifesto, install, footer)
direction contract HTML comment present as first child of body per new-work.md section 5
dual CTA (Chrome Web Store + GitHub) present together wherever install is offered
no ad-skipping claims, no fabricated testimonials/star counts
responsive at desktop + mobile
cards.merge_gate: detect.mjs run once with findings triaged; hero-repro screenshot saved to .impeccable/review/

cards.title: React code quality review
acceptance: hook correctness, render performance, and component structure reviewed

cards.title: Accessibility review
acceptance: contrast, semantics, keyboard nav, alt text on all authored imagery reviewed against WCAG 2.2

cards.title: Design/finish review against the direction contract
acceptance: build matches direction contract and surface brief; screenshots at desktop+mobile pass critique
cards.merge_gate: verdict = ship (or fix round resolved and re-verdicted, max 2 rounds per new-work.md)

cards.title: Apply batched fixes from all three reviews
acceptance: every P0/P1 finding from the three reviews addressed in one batch, not per-tweak
cards.merge_gate: re-screenshot + one re-verdict pass from review-design confirms resolution

cards.title: Write DESIGN.md from the built world
acceptance: DESIGN.md exists and describes the shipped system, not intention

cards.title: Merge scaffold + assets + landing-page into main
acceptance: all branches merged, no conflicts, build green on main
cards.merge_gate: final `npm run build` on main passes
